labels.name: documentation
labels.rationale: Reports a broken link in the root documentation; the request to contribute the fix does not change the kind.

body:
Thanks for finding the broken link. Pull requests from outside the core team are currently limited to collaborators, so please open an issue describing the broken link (the file and the link target) and the fix you have in mind. For how contributions work, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
